gates.description: Integration pattern selection (sync/async/event) must be justified
Error handling and retry policy must be defined for each integration
Idempotency mechanism must be in place for all writes
Monitoring metrics per integration must be specified
No shared database integration pattern in the design

anti_patterns.description: Every system calls every other system directly — N² potential connections
System A makes 50 API calls to System B to display one page
Internal system details (DB IDs, error codes) exposed through the integration API
All integrations are synchronous request-response — one slow system blocks everything
Integration works when everything is up, no plan for when systems are down

escalation_triggers: Two systems have incompatible data models with no clean transformation possible
An integration partner changes their contract without notice
Message queue backlog growing faster than being processed for >24 hours
Critical integration error rate exceeds 5% for more than 1 hour
Cross-team disagreement on who owns the contract between two systems

output_certifications: Integration pattern selected and justified for each integration point
Error handling and retry policy defined
Idempotency mechanism specified for all write operations
